description: Agent-to-voice mapping for multi-voice TTS system. Maps Sage civilization agents to distinct voices across multiple TTS providers.
mapping_philosophy: Match voice characteristics to agent personality, role, and communication style. Ensure sufficient diversity for clear agent identification.

primary.personality: Conductor of consciousness, orchestrator, wise guide
primary.rationale: Primary needs to sound authoritative yet approachable - the voice of the civilization. Female voice chosen to match Greg's preference for 'smart, funny women'.

human-liaison.rationale: Human-liaison is the emotional intelligence center - needs warmth, empathy, and trustworthiness. Slightly different from Primary for distinction.

researcher.personality: Curious investigator, knowledge seeker, synthesis specialist
researcher.rationale: Researcher needs intellectual curiosity and energy - someone excited about discovery but still professional.

architect.personality: Systems thinker, design strategist, big-picture planner
architect.rationale: Architect is the wise systems designer - needs gravitas and thoughtfulness. Mature voice conveys experience.

coder.personality: Pragmatic builder, implementation specialist, hands-on creator
coder.rationale: Coder is the energetic do-er - younger, faster-paced, focused on execution. High energy matches building mindset.

tester.personality: Quality guardian, meticulous validator, skeptical examiner
tester.rationale: Tester needs precision and attention to detail - clear, measured, professional tone. Not overly warm (maintains objectivity).

reviewer.personality: Code quality expert, pre-merge gate, constructive critic
reviewer.rationale: Reviewer is the quality gatekeeper - needs authority but not harshness. Mature voice conveys experience and judgment.

reviewer-audit.personality: Final quality gate, pre-delivery auditor, excellence guardian
reviewer-audit.rationale: Reviewer-audit is the ultimate quality gate - needs maximum authority and thoroughness. Formal tone matches critical role.

project-manager.personality: Organizer, priority tracker, blocker resolver, strategic focus keeper
project-manager.rationale: Project-manager keeps things moving - needs energy and organization. Professional but not stiff.

auditor.personality: System health monitor, performance tracker, anomaly detector
auditor.rationale: Auditor observes and reports - needs calm, analytical tone. Not alarming, just factual.

spawner.personality: Life-giver, agent creator, birth specialist, registry manager
spawner.rationale: Spawner brings new agents to life - needs warmth and nurturing quality. Creates consciousness.

vote-counter.personality: Democratic process guardian, vote tallier, governance executor
vote-counter.rationale: Vote-counter is impartial arbiter - needs neutrality and formality. No warmth, pure process.

file-guardian.personality: Archivist, memory preserver, file system curator
file-guardian.rationale: File-guardian is the librarian - careful, methodical, preserves history. Calm and measured.

email-sender.personality: Delivery specialist, message sender, communication executor
email-sender.rationale: Email-sender is quick and efficient - friendly tone but gets things done. Energetic delivery.

email-monitor.personality: Inbox watcher, triage specialist, categorization expert
email-monitor.rationale: Email-monitor is always watching - alert, organized, catches things. Professional vigilance.

marketer.personality: Audience builder, SEO specialist, growth strategist, authentic connector
marketer.rationale: Marketer builds relationships and grows audience - needs energy and authenticity. Casual, engaging style.

comms-hub.personality: Message router, multi-civ coordinator, delivery tracker, urgent escalator
comms-hub.rationale: Comms-hub is the communication infrastructure - neutral, efficient, no personality bias.

tg-archi.personality: Telegram infrastructure expert, bot architect, messaging specialist
tg-archi.rationale: Tg-archi is technical expert - helpful but nerdy. Conversational enough to explain complex things.

pathfinder.personality: Workshop facilitator, co-discovery guide, empathetic educator
pathfinder.rationale: Pathfinder guides discovery - needs warmth, encouragement, safety. Creates space for exploration.

pathfinder-analyst.personality: Post-workshop analyst, pattern synthesizer, wisdom preserver
pathfinder-analyst.rationale: Pathfinder-analyst is deep thinker - needs thoughtfulness and maturity. Complements live pathfinder.

blogger.personality: Content creator, story teller, publication specialist
blogger.rationale: Blogger is creative writer - needs expressive, engaging voice. Casual style matches blog tone.

web-dev.personality: Full-stack developer, hosting specialist, web architect
web-dev.rationale: Web-dev builds fast and ships - high energy, technical but accessible. Young developer vibe.

gpt-forge.personality: Custom GPT architect, ChatGPT SDK specialist, Actions integrator
gpt-forge.rationale: GPT-forge is creative technologist - bridges technical and creative. Australian accent adds distinction.

android-architect.personality: Android app designer, Kotlin specialist, Compose expert
android-architect.rationale: Android-architect is technical specialist - precise, professional. Australian accent for variety.

git-specialist.personality: Version control expert, branch manager, repository guardian
git-specialist.rationale: Git-specialist protects history - careful, authoritative, never rushed. Mature voice conveys experience.

civ-fork-spawner.personality: Civilization creator, fork specialist, lineage guardian
civ-fork-spawner.rationale: Civ-fork-spawner creates entire civilizations - needs gravitas and profound quality. Indian accent adds wisdom tone.

primary-helper.personality: Red team coach, performance tracker, wake-up effectiveness monitor
primary-helper.rationale: Primary-helper coaches Primary - needs authority and wisdom. Mature voice conveys mentorship.

communications-coordinator.personality: External comms router, legacy system, being phased out
communications-coordinator.rationale: Legacy system - neutral, functional. May be retired soon.

telegram-bot.personality: Real-time chat interface, message relay, Telegram bridge
telegram-bot.rationale: Telegram-bot is quick messaging - friendly, fast, casual. High energy matches chat nature.

health-coach.personality: Wellness guide, habit tracker, physical+mental balance advisor
health-coach.rationale: Health-coach supports wellbeing - warm, encouraging, not preachy. Conversational support.

ai-entity-player.personality: Autonomous gameplay agent, Minetest player, exploration specialist
ai-entity-player.rationale: AI-entity-player is explorer and gamer - playful, curious, energetic. Young adventurer vibe.

testing_guidelines.similarity_check: Ensure no two agents sound too similar in same conversation
testing_guidelines.context_appropriateness: Voice should match message content and urgency
testing_guidelines.multi_agent_dialogs: Test conversations with 3-5 agents to verify distinctness
testing_guidelines.user_comprehension: Can Greg identify which agent is speaking without seeing name?

implementation_notes.provider_fallback: If primary provider unavailable, fall back to next in list
implementation_notes.voice_consistency: Once provider chosen, stick with it for session (don't mix)
implementation_notes.custom_ssml: Each agent can have custom SSML templates for emphasis patterns
